title: Model Card Compiler
description: Compiles model cards (Google Model Cards standard). Enforces intended use, training data description, evaluation metrics across subgroups, ethical considerations, out-of-scope use cases, and limitations.

error_codes.MC002: Intended use not defined — model card must state purpose and target users
error_codes.MC003: Training data not described — dataset version, size, and splits must be documented
error_codes.MC004: Performance metrics incomplete — metrics for ALL relevant subgroups required
error_codes.MC005: Ethical considerations section missing — bias, fairness, and societal impact required
error_codes.MC006: Out-of-scope use cases not defined — what the model must NOT be used for
